topic: Print-on-demand niches that are not oversaturated yet
angle: Everyone sells cat mugs. The money is in the three niches almost nobody covers.
hook: 3 print-on-demand niches almost nobody is selling in — and where the money still hides
caption:
Print on demand is not dead. Selling generic cat mugs on Etsy is dead. Three specific niches still have almost no serious sellers and huge search volume. This is not financial advice. It is where I would start if I were beginning today. Which niche surprises you the most?

items.title: Niche hobbies
items.desc: Bouldering. Aquascaping. Restoration. Fanbases exist. Sellers do not.

items.title: Professional jokes
items.desc: Anesthesiology memes. Devops in-jokes. Small audience, high margin.

items.title: Regional Indian humor
items.desc: Tamil, Malayalam, Marathi jokes on shirts. Nobody serves this market.

slides.title: Find your niche with EtsyRank
slides.body: Use EtsyRank free tier. Filter for search volume above 500 and less than 200 competing listings. Three niches will jump out immediately.

slides.text: The Bouldering Grandma tote hit Rs 3L in profit in a year. Seller was one person in Pune. Nobody talks about it.
Save this. Pick a niche you actually understand and mock up 3 designs this week.
